Based on RndMnkIII's NES Analogizer v1.1.0, adapted from agg23's NES core. Adds Composite Blend to the Pocket and Analogizer RGB paths: Off, Kitrinx Style, NTSC Light/Medium/Strong, and PAL Light/Medium/Strong/Strong+. The filter approximates luma/chroma bandwidth; it is not a composite waveform encoder. Configure Analogizer with analogizer.bin in /Assets/analogizer/common.

Composite Blend filters by snckrz. Analogizer support by RndMnkIII; NES Pocket port by agg23; original core by Ludvig Strigeus, sorgelig, greyrogue, Kitrinx, paulb-nl, and many others.
